description_en: Query the details of a broadcast device, including the device status and free space
description_zh: 查询播报设备的详情，包括设备的状态、设备的可用空间等
name: GetSpeechDeviceDetail

parameters.description_en: The ID issued by the IoT Platform for a device, which serves as the device's Unique Identifier. You can obtain this parameter by invoking [QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~).
parameters.description_zh: 物联网平台为设备颁发的ID，是设备的唯一标识符。调用[QuerySpeechDevice](~~280408~~)可以获取该参数。
parameters.help_en: The ID issued by the IoT Platform for a device, which serves as the device's Unique Identifier. You can obtain this parameter by invoking https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html

parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.description_en:
Instance ID.

You must provide the instance ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** Page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
></notice>
